overview: A local Node.js dashboard for CSV/XLSX sales-call exports. Active reporting is limited to source facts, exact stable-ID relationships, conservative literal transcript detections, and manager-authored overlays. Historical Qwen output is a research archive with no authority.
objective: Provide a system managers can use confidently by showing only evidence-backed facts and explicit unknowns, while preventing unpromoted model output from driving any operational decision.

steps: Load and normalize a local call CSV/XLSX without copying it into Git.
Deduplicate by call_id and compute permitted source facts.
Build exact stable-ID reattempt relationships without claiming completion or quality.
Detect only recognised literal no-answer, machine/carrier voicemail/system audio, direct Customer wrong number, direct Customer opt-out, and literal AI-assistant phrases.
Persist the active deterministic projection to intelligence.sqlite with semantic fields null.
Merge non-destructive alert and manager-review overlays.
Render six workspaces plus transcript proof pages.
Expose historical model artifacts only as research with authority none.
Expose every registered capability's exact scope, provenance, exclusions, failure evidence, authority, and permitted next action.
Build isolated genuinely-unseen benchmark manifests and freeze exact-quote human truth separately from manager review and the historical archive.
Compute exact voicemail prompts, literal callback requests, stable-ID chronology, later inbound relationships, and observed handling without causal or commercial inference.
Optionally validate a local voicemail-pilot export against exact call IDs, source timestamps, stable IDs, event provenance and CRM proof without persisting raw pilot rows.
Reject every model submission or operational consumption while the exact capability is unpromoted.

architecture: src/main.js: HTTP server, health, UI/API routes, and fail-closed mutation boundaries
src/localModelCapability.js: pinned register validation and submission/consumption assertions
src/evaluationValidationLab.js: isolated unseen manifests, exact-quote labels, immutable freezes, and strict candidate comparisons
src/voicemailPilotAttribution.js: optional read-only pilot attribution, commercial proof and equal-window experiment gating
src/analysis.js: source profiling, filters, stable-ID facts, literal alerts, and manager overlays
src/transcriptIntelligence.js: literal events/outcomes and exact evidence with semantic attributes null
src/storage.js: local state, reports, alerts, reviews, and archive coordination
src/evaluationStudioDatabase.js: historical Evaluation Studio SQLite archive
src/aiExecutionLayer.js: guarded local-service client; submission/polling denied when unpromoted

state.evaluation_studio: controlled validation workspace with a separate immutable historical research archive
state.benchmark_partitions: smoke 10, development 50, promotion at least 100, shadow 25
state.scheduled_model_task: present but disabled; controller capability preflight remains fail closed
state.voicemail_pilot_store: none; raw rows and the sanitized report are in-memory only

guardrails.model_submission: fail closed unless the exact capability is explicitly promoted
guardrails.operational_consumption: fail closed unless the exact capability is explicitly promoted
guardrails.phone_matching: forbidden; use permitted exact source IDs only
guardrails.untrusted_legacy_fields: NoSaleType and Baz_DetailedNotes are raw-source-only and excluded everywhere active
guardrails.commercial_claims: sales, payment, fulfilment, revenue, ROI, and CRM outcomes are unsupported
guardrails.qwen_spiel: v3-v6 stopped; no same-model rescue or further inference
guardrails.benchmark_authority: human calibration truth only; a passing comparison requires external approval and never self-promotes
guardrails.voicemail_inbound_claims: exact deterministic evidence only; callback causation, receptiveness, conversion, sale, revenue, profit, and ROI remain unknown
guardrails.voicemail_pilot_claims: exact source-contract facts only; invalid assignments are excluded, invalid measures are not_scored, incomplete or unequal windows withhold lift, and currencies remain separate
guardrails.fixture_uat_store: must set an isolated SALES_DASHBOARD_STORE_PATH; never use the default active store
